avoid_supplements.name: High-dose mineral oil supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance laxative effect and increase risk of diarrhea/dehydration
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; separate administration if necessary

caution_supplements.name: Psyllium husk/Fiber supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive effects on bowel motility; may increase loose stools
caution_supplements.action: Monitor stool frequency and consistency; adjust fiber intake as needed

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate GI effects; limited clinical data on interaction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor GI tolerance; separate dosing if feasible

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay GI motility and affect plecanatide absorption timing
caution_foods.action: Consistent meal timing recommended; plecanatide may be taken with or without food

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages (coffee, tea, energy drinks)
caution_foods.mechanism: Stimulates GI motility; additive effects with plecanatide may increase urgency
caution_foods.action: Counsel on potential increased bowel urgency; monitor tolerance

monitoring_notes: Plecanatide has minimal systemic absorption and is not significantly metabolized by hepatic enzymes, resulting in very low drug-supplement/food interaction potential. Monitor for excessive diarrhea, dehydration, and electrolyte abnormalities, particularly during initiation or with concurrent GI-active agents.
